title: spaex Install Lockfile v4 (npm/pip-shape simplification)
description: Schema for `.spaex/install.lock`. Structurally identical to the v3 npm/pip-shape (Spec 008 2026-09-03 amendment); only the version-field name (`haex_hive_version` -> `spaex_version`) and value (`3` -> `4`) change. Legacy generated_by, constitution, atoms, contributed_paths, generation_inputs, participating_roots, and visibility_marker fields remain rejected by the schema/migration gate.

generation_id.description: This generation's identifier. install.lock is the sole publication record; there is no separate visibility.json file.

molecules.$comment: The post-schema semantic validator requires lexicographic (id, source, revision, paths) ordering. JSON Schema cannot compare properties across array items. uniqueItems rejects duplicate full tuples.
molecules.description: One entry per resolved molecule, canonically ordered by (id, source, revision, paths). Constitution provenance, participating roots, and tool/adapter identity are all derivable from this array rather than tracked separately.

revision.description: Immutable full commit SHA per Constitution Principle IV.

paths.description: Unique, deterministically ordered POSIX paths relative to the consumer repository root that this molecule wrote. Every path implicitly names its participating root (its leading dot-segment); there is no separate participating_roots list.
